title: speedhose
blurb: type a handle and speedhose blasts every word from the accounts you follow, live off the firehose, one word at a time at 500 wpm in a looping 2000-word buffer. @shimmermathlabs.com riffed on @angussoftware.dev's feed-that-speeds-up-instead-of-slowing-down bit.
